summary_pt: Novo protótipo frontal em avaliação: corpo guiado pelas articulações do Bento e peças originais separadas. Oito poses com preparação, golpe e recuperação. A arte final e as outras direções ainda não estão aprovadas; personagem publicado preservado.
motion_review: Arm on frame2 no longer follows removed blade. Source stance changes and torso rotation are visible. Hand grips must be fitted independently before any weapon layer is accepted.
visible_piece_limits: Visible original source pixels only, not reconstruction of hidden garment surfaces.
Weapon includes original contact effects; not a new interchangeable sword model.
South attack only. Idle/Walk and all other directions are not certified for this outfit.

grip_contact_proxy.method: warm skin pixels and source weapon pixels within a manually selected7x7 hand region; Chebyshev distance. Auxiliary geometric evidence, not artistic approval.
